He speaks from inside the Finance Committee ('we'll know more after we meet on Thursday', 413; 'we'll be deciding what we're going to send to the rest of the board', 439; 'we did that last year, made sure the whole board got [it]', 452), asks the DRA public-hearing deadline (466), moves to endorse the school-funding letter (498, 500-501, 505) and then raises the point of order that kills his own motion (507, 509, 511). TWO STATEMENTS IN THIS CLUSTER PULL IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS AND THE CONFLICT IS LEFT OPEN. For Sprague: 'So. So I went to Stephen's High school a really long time ago. And when I went there, we also had a seven period day' (255) matches his own words in `15205 SchoolBoard071923.mp4.CSV`, where he says 'That was not the case when I went there' about Stevens and 'being a high school principal, three different high schools'; and the school-insider framing of 'we used to have a partnership with Dartmouth' (88) and 'We used to have a program also called Educational Talent Search' (104) fits a retired district administrator. Against Sprague: 'So both of our kids participated in that because I'm not considered to have a higher degree because I only have an associate's degree... both my my wife and I both have socialist [associate's] degrees. So my kids are considered to have parents that don't have higher education' (105) - EVERY WORD OF IT AT ASR CONFIDENCE 1.00 - cannot be squared with a principal of three high schools. COMPETING READING, STATED PLAINLY: this cluster has two blocks that never interleave - a PSAT/schedule block (496-3336 s) carrying NO name anchor at all, and a budget block (4056-5092 s) carrying every one of the 'Frank' anchors above - separated by twelve minutes of silence. A merge of two men (this diarizer's commonest failure) therefore cannot be excluded, and Michael Petrin is the seated member who would be the other man. The cluster is kept as one person because the Stevens-alumnus self-description independently matches Sprague, because register and topic are continuous across both blocks, and because Petrin is not named, addressed or otherwise evidenced anywhere in this recording. A human should settle the associate's-degree line. Segment 421 is the chair's sentence-tail and is reassigned.
